name: nem0/OpenFBX
description: Lightweight open-source FBX importer that loads geometry, skeletons, animations, blend shapes, materials, textures, cameras, and lights without the proprietary Autodesk SDK.
score_rationale: Only practical open-source pure-C FBX importer with 1.3k stars, used in both Lumix Engine and Flax Engine, though development slowed after 2021.
summary: Open-source FBX importer for geometry, skeletons, animations without SDK
